platform: FUXWITHIT Premiere Feature and Interview Editorial Email Route
manual_review_reason: FUXWITHIT publicly invites premiere opportunities, feature requests and interview requests through fuxwithitdotcom@gmail.com, but it does not publish a complete music-delivery specification, response policy, release-window rule, file/link format, rights declaration or AI-content policy. A human must choose a strongly relevant MarcsMusic release and editorial angle, verify release and premiere availability, prepare an authorized private stream or non-expiring link and concise press context, approve all metadata and personal data, and send the email manually. Advertising must not be treated as an editorial shortcut.

platform: Run The Trap First-Party SoundCloud Music Submission Form Route
manual_review_reason: Run The Trap accepts new music through its first-party Contact Us + Submit Music form and requires a private or live SoundCloud stream; MP3 attachments and social-media submissions are rejected. A human must inspect the live form for any runtime antispam or consent controls, choose a fitting track, write the requested descriptive subject and concise message, verify SoundCloud access and rights, confirm whether the release or mix is eligible, approve all personal data and submit manually. Mixes are accepted only from established artists and must be exclusive to the publication.
